_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: In the wilderness, the serpent was lifted up.
Whoever looked to it lived.
So must the Son of Man be lifted up.
For God so loved the world.
We were dead, and grace made us alive.
By grace we have been saved.
Come out of the dark and into the light.
We come to the light of the world. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: In the desert they were dying of their own venom, until Moses lifted up a sign and the dying looked and lived.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
So must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever looks to him in faith will not perish but live.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
We were dead in our wandering, and God, rich in mercy, breathed us back to life.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
For God so loved the world that the light came, and the darkness could not hold us.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
So step out of the shadows; give thanks, you whom the Lord has redeemed.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Lifted in the desert, the sign that healed.
Lead us in your way.
So the Son of Man is lifted up for us.
Lead us in your way.
Dead in our wandering, grace made us alive.
Lead us in your way.
Out of the dark, into the light we come.
Lead us in your way. Amen.
